<!-- Code generated by xgen. DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!-- Source: xgen/screens/src/authoring/blocks/landing.ts -->
<!--
  A section with a heading and one PricingCard per plan. Axes: layout (grid, stack), columns, emphasis, billing
  (off: no toggle; monthly or annual: a toggle with that choice selected, and the prices of that period),
  density, tone.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { BillingLabels } from "./pricing-tiers.types";
  import type { Plan, PricingCardLabels } from "./pricing-card.types";

  export type PricingTiersProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    plans: Plan[];
    labels: PricingCardLabels;
    billingLabels: BillingLabels;
    layout?: "grid" | "stack";
    cols?: "1-2" | "1-3" | "1-4";
    emphasis?: "auto" | "off";
    billing?: "off" | "monthly" | "annual";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    density?: "roomy" | "default" | "compact";
    onselect?: (id: string) => void;
    onbilling?: (period: string) => void;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Badge from "../primitives/badge/badge.svelte";
  import Grid from "../primitives/grid/grid.svelte";
  import Group from "../primitives/group/group.svelte";
  import PricingCard from "../blocks/pricing-card.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import Switcher from "../components/switcher.svelte";
  import SwitcherItem from "../components/switcher-item.svelte";
  import { fitCols } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    plans,
    labels,
    billingLabels,
    layout = "grid",
    cols = "1-3",
    emphasis = "auto",
    billing = "off",
    tone = "default",
    density = "default",
    onselect,
    onbilling,
  }: PricingTiersProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame
  id={id}
  title={title}
  tone={tone}
  density={density}
  measure={(((layout as string) === "stack") ? "md" : "default")}
>
  {#if ((billing as string) !== "off")}
    <Group gap="4" align="center" justify="center" class="flex-wrap" data-testid="billing">
      <Switcher label={billingLabels.label}>
        <SwitcherItem active={((billing as string) === "monthly")} onclick={() => onbilling?.("monthly")}>
          {billingLabels.monthly}
        </SwitcherItem>
        <SwitcherItem active={((billing as string) === "annual")} onclick={() => onbilling?.("annual")}>
          {billingLabels.annual}
        </SwitcherItem>
      </Switcher>
      <Badge variant="default" size="default">
        {billingLabels.save}
      </Badge>
    </Group>
  {/if}
  <Grid
    cols={(((layout as string) === "stack") ? "1" : fitCols(cols, (plans?.length ?? 0)))}
    class="gap-4"
    data-testid="tiers"
  >
    {#each plans as plan (plan.id)}
      <PricingCard
        plan={plan}
        labels={labels}
        emphasis={emphasis}
        billing={(((billing as string) === "annual") ? "annual" : "monthly")}
        density={(((density as string) === "compact") ? "compact" : "default")}
        onselect={() => onselect?.(plan.id)}
      />
    {/each}
  </Grid>
</SectionFrame>
